# Sketch.IO

> Sketch.IO is the creator of Sketchpad, a digital drawing and design tool offering both web and desktop applications, alongside SketchAPI for developers.

Sketch.IO develops creative software solutions centered around Sketchpad, a versatile digital drawing platform used for graphics design, educational purposes, and professional creative work. The company is based in Clackamas, Oregon and provides comprehensive documentation, licensing information, and support resources for its products.

## Key Topics

- Sketchpad
- SketchAPI
- Digital drawing tool
- Creative software
- Graphics design
- Drawing brushes
- Design features
- Web and desktop apps
- License agreement
- Educational products
- Portfolio and case studies
- Design tools
- Clipart library
- Photo editing

- [Privacy Policy](https://sketch.io/privacy-policy.html): Privacy policy covering data collection, retention, and DMCA procedures

- [End User License Agreement](https://sketch.io/eula): End User License Agreement for Sketchpad desktop software licensing
